```json
{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "Aspect-based decomposition of the Yelp dining experience (service, food/product quality, and value/pricing) with per-aspect sentiment and sub-dimension detail",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "service_sentiment", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures sentiment toward the service aspect -- a core experiential facet reviewers discuss."},
    {"name": "service_failure_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Drills into specific service problems (rude, slow, inattentive), giving actionable granularity within the service facet."},
    {"name": "food_product_sentiment", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Sentiment toward the food/product aspect, a second coherent experiential facet."},
    {"name": "product_quality_dimension", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Decomposes food quality into flavor, temperature, portion, freshness -- a well-differentiated sub-facet structure."},
    {"name": "value_pricing_sentiment", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Sentiment toward the value/price aspect, completing a standard aspect trio for dining reviews."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.95,
  "structure_quality": 0.9,
  "focus_actionability": 0.9,
  "rationale": "The columns centre tightly on one coherent, data-inferable focus: aspect-based analysis of the dining experience. They cover three canonical experiential aspects (service, food, value) and pair a sentiment column with a categorical sub-dimension column for two of them (failure_type, quality_dimension), yielding a genuine two-level analytical structure rather than a single restatement or generic noise. This directly answers 'what aspects are reviewers talking about' and lets an analyst quantify which aspects drive positive/negative experience and why. Minor gaps: value/pricing lacks a parallel sub-dimension column, and other plausible aspects (ambiance/atmosphere, cleanliness, wait/reservation) are absent, slightly narrowing full coverage of 'aspects of experience' -- but the realised set is disciplined, differentiated, and clearly actionable."
}
```
